steps.en: The officer opens the decision screen from the dashboard work item
steps.id: Officer membuka layar keputusan dari work item di dashboard
steps.why_en: The screen opens from a notice list on a hidden page, not from a dashboard work item.
steps.why_id: Layar dibuka dari daftar notice di halaman tersembunyi, bukan dari work item di dashboard.

steps.en: The officer marks the decision: offer composition or charge in court
steps.id: Officer menandai keputusan: tawarkan composition atau lanjut ke pengadilan
steps.why_en: The form exists, but the choice cannot be saved anywhere.
steps.why_id: Formnya ada, tapi pilihannya tidak bisa disimpan di mana pun.

steps.en: The officer enters the composition amount payable
steps.id: Officer mengisi jumlah composition yang harus dibayar
steps.why_en: The amount can be typed in, but it is never applied to the notice.
steps.why_id: Jumlahnya bisa diketik, tapi tidak pernah diterapkan ke notice.

steps.en: The decision is saved on the notice
steps.why_en: The system has no place to save it, so a deployed build shows an error.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya tempat menyimpannya, jadi build yang sudah deploy menampilkan error.

steps.en: The decision is routed to the 2OIC for endorsement
steps.why_en: Work is assigned to the same officer, no 2OIC role exists, and nothing receives it.
steps.why_id: Pekerjaan dialokasikan ke officer yang sama, peran 2OIC tidak ada, dan tidak ada yang menerimanya.
